description: This bar chart illustrates the popularity scores for different large language models (LLMs) across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled “Movies”, “Songs”, and “Basketball” in that order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Popularity”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 220, with tick marks at intervals of 20. For each category, there are three sets of grouped bars, each representing a different LLM: Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow). Additionally, within each LLM group, there are three stacked bars representing different accuracy levels: “Acc=0 & GT Ans” (patterned), “Acc=0 & Gene Ans” (diagonal lines), and “Acc=1 & GT Ans” (white). In the “Movies” category, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 28, Qwen2 reaches approximately 52, and ChatGPT reaches approximately 36. For “Songs”, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 68, Qwen2 reaches approximately 88, and ChatGPT reaches approximately 64. In the “Basketball” category, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 184, Qwen2 reaches approximately 212, and ChatGPT reaches approximately 140. The bars are arranged in groups by category, and within each group, the LLMs are consistently ordered as Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT from left to right. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
